content.body: In every sense of the word, the SdKfz.7 proved essential to the Wehrmacht. Over 12,000 SdKfz.7s were manufactured by the time production ceased in 1944. Able to pull 8 tons, they were ideal for towing the legendary 88mm FlaK.36.
content.brief: TYPE: Prime Mover TOWING CAPACITY: Heavy LOAD: 7990 kg WEIGHT: 11550 kg SPEED (on road): 50 km/h
